verdict.rationale: Temporal provides Schedules for recurring/autonomous workflow execution, durable execution with automatic crash recovery and retries, and explicit AI agent/workflow orchestration integrations (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK, AgentCore serverless workers) that let background automations run unattended. Community reports corroborate durability guarantees but also flag rough edges in error visibility and self-hosting docs. Missing for 10: independent large-scale case study specifically of AI-native autonomous agents running unattended long-term, and resolution of noted gaps in failure/error observability.
